item.title: Abaqus rotational model
item.description:
Coupling Constraint

  1. inner circular walls

  2. the whole body exclude beforementioned inner walls and the upper&lower surfaces of those bolts (can’t let two points control one with its all DOFs， the upper&lower surfaces of those bolts controled by two points seperately will fail due to their shared edges)

  3. the honeycomb walls clipped by the square clamp （surface-to-surface interactions failed, make the 2nd coupling constraint and 3rd ones shared the same RFs）
